trap-triples.evidence: The three iff conditions are a genuine enumeration: incompleteness, low crossing energy, site availability are distinct predicates and the Lean sibling carries all three as separate fields. Condition 3's first sentence ('R contains at least one open linking site') IS implied by condition 1 (|R| < 2n^2 means the outer shell is not full), so the iff is non-minimal, but condition 3's second sentence adds a real requirement the others do not state — that the linking must not disrupt the closed inner shells S_i. That extra content is what keeps this a substantive three rather than a padded one.
trap-triples.notes: pass. THREE FINDINGS, none fixed inline. (1) NOTATION-REGISTER VIOLATION (STRICT): the block writes 'Let A(p,n) be a stable atom' and 'E = p . T_{2,3}' with p the electron/proton COUNT. AGENTS.md's collision rules reserve p for a brane point and specify that the proton count is Z ('$ = brane point (never proton; proton is $\mathfrak{p}$, proton count is $)'). Proposed: A(Z,N) and E = Z . T_{2,3}. The same sentence also overloads n — the atom's neutron count in A(p,n) against the principal quantum number in 2n_{k+1}^2 two lines later. (2) SELF-ASSUMING LEAN PROJECTION: the lean.ref resolves to lean/QOU/Archimedean/metallic_character_knot.lean, which declares 'class MetallicCharacterContext' carrying the block's own conclusion as a field, 'claim_metallic_iff : forall a, IsMetallic a <-> (OuterShellIncomplete a AND LowOuterCrossingEnergy a AND HasOpenSite a)', and then a theorem whose entire proof is 'ctx.claim_metallic_iff a'. That is the exact anti-pattern AGENTS.md 3b-cond item 5 names — the class axiomatises the CONCLUSION rather than the hypotheses, and the theorem derives nothing. Nothing about atoms, shells, sub-Hopf links or crossing energy is encoded: Atom is an opaque Type and all four predicates are opaque Atom -> Prop. Proposed: follow the verified exemplar the same section cites, QOU/FluidDynamics/q_bkm_criterion.lean, carrying the two directions as separate hypotheses and composing them by Iff.intro. (3) DEAD Ref PATH: that Lean file's '-- Ref:' points at quantum-observable-universe/archimedean-universe/metallic-character-knot.md; there is no archimedean-universe/ directory in folio/quantum-observable-universe/ and the block lives in predicted-spectra/.
